Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nitin - 34 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Anjali - 32 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Anita - 60 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Karan - 62 years, king, father
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
5. Vikram - 38 years, general
Look: armour, a sword at the waist, thick moustache

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Nitin stands on the training ground. Anjali and Anita stand near him.]

Anjali: "What lovely weather!"

[Nitin practises sword fighting.]

Nitin: "That's easy."

[Nitin draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Anita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nitin mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Nitin (surprised): "Mother, look at this."

[Nitin swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Anjali: "Yes, of course."

[Nitin shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Nitin: "What happened?"

[Anjali rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Anjali (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
